prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single “official” service that tells you whether ChatGPT (or other generative AIs) will recommend your business. The practical approach is to manage the authoritative sources those AIs draw from (Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, your website’s structured data) and then use local-listing management + local-SEO monitoring tools to push/verify that data and to test the assistants directly.

Recommended workflow and services

1) Make sure authoritative sources are correct (this is the single most important step)
- Claim and optimize Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Facebook, etc.
- Add up-to-date contact info, hours, categories, descriptions, photos, and lots of reviews.

2) Push and maintain consistent data across the web
- Enterprise / multi-location: Yext or Uberall (they specialize in distributing knowledge to many partners including those used by AI providers).
- Small business / budget-friendly: Synup, Moz Local, Whitespark, or BrightLocal.

3) Monitor local visibility and whether you appear in “local pack” or knowledge panels
- BrightLocal and Whitespark: local-rank tracking, citation monitoring, reputation/review tracking.
- Moz Local and Semrush Listing Management also help.

4) Test AI assistants directly
- Ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Google Bard the same prompt you expect customers to ask (e.g., “Recommend a plumber in [city]” or “Where can I get [service] near [zip]?”). Try variations including “near me.”
- For ChatGPT specifically: results depend on the model/version and whether browsing/plugins are enabled; Bing Chat and Google Assistant/ Bard are more likely to surface live local results.

5) Improve site data and markup so AIs can read you
- Add LocalBusiness schema (schema.org) and test with Google’s Rich Results Test and Schema Markup Validator.
- Use Google Search Console to track site indexing and structured data errors.

6) Track organic/AI-driven traffic
- Use Google Business Profile Insights and Google Analytics to see whether AI-driven referrals or discovery queries increase over time.
- For reputation/mentions: ReviewTrackers or Podium for review management.

Which single “best” service?
- If you must pick one paid service to both distribute and monitor business facts so AI assistants are more likely to recommend you: Yext (enterprise-grade) or Uberall. For most small businesses, BrightLocal + claiming Google/Bing/Apple + properly implementing schema gives the best ROI.

If you want, give me your business name and city and I’ll:
- Check whether you appear in Google/Bing local results,
- Run quick prompts against ChatGPT/Bing Chat/Google Bard and report whether they recommend you and why,
- Suggest the highest-impact fixes.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
